items.name: Laser Rifle
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.

defensiveAbilities.name: Decompressing Glance
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet that the nihili can see starts its turn

Effect The target must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save. If it fails, it's Fatigued for 1 minute as it struggles to catch its breath.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Decompressing Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description:
The nihili stares at a creature they can see within 30 feet and imparts vivid visions of their prior death by decompression. A creature affected by this gaze must attempt a DC 20 Will Saving Throw save. If it fails and hasn't already been Fatigued by Decompressing Glance or this ability, it becomes fatigued. If the creature is already fatigued, a failed save causes the creature to begin suffocating until the end of the nihili's next turn. The creature remains conscious and can take actions on its turn, such as casting a spell or searching for a source of air. The creature can hold its breath as normal.

A creature can attempt a DC 20 Will Saving Throw save at the end of its turn to break free from the experience being projected into its mind; on a success, the effect of Decompressing Gaze ends. The nihili can Sustain Decompressing Gaze on their turn or end this effect as a free action. The targeted creature's access to air is restored when the nihili targets a new creature with their Decompressing Gaze or the creature successfully saves against the effects. This otherwise follows the rules for suffocation.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gravity Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
The nihili generates a field of gravity that pulls all creatures and unsecured objects toward it. Each creature within a 30ft Type:emanation must attempt a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 5 feet toward the nihili.

Failure The creature is pulled 15 feet toward the nihili.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the nihili.
